title: livery.yml
description: A livery's engine knobs, beside its _brand.yml (the colors, fonts and logos). Fractions are of the slide's height unless a key says width. A flavor (extends:) names only what differs from its parent.

schema.description: The schema this file is written for: 1.

name.description: The livery's name, as LIVERY= picks it.

extends.description: A parent livery beside this one: this livery wears everything of the parent's that it does not name itself.

roles.description: Which palette color plays each part of the slides. A value is a _brand.yml palette name or a #RRGGBB hex; primary, secondary, foreground and background default to _brand.yml's.

primary.description: The brand's main color: the cover, section and closing fields, table headers, links.

secondary.description: The second brand color: the waves, the section slide's eyebrow, selection highlights.

primary-text.description: Text set on the primary field (titles on the cover, section and closing slides).

primary-contrast.description: The primary color where it is small text on the paper (links, note callouts); a darker primary when the primary is too light to read.

accent.description: The accent tab beside titles; caution and warning callouts; the base of alert text in code.

highlight.description: A second small-text accent on the paper: tips, examples, strings in code.

muted.description: Captions, footnotes, asides, block quotes and other quiet text.

surface.description: The pale fill behind code blocks and table bands.

warning.description: The bar of a caution slide; its soft fill is the caution-fill blend.

dark.description: The darkest field: the feature slide's bar and panel, dark slides, and code text unless code-text says otherwise.

code-text.description: Code text (default: the dark role; a dark livery's dark is a field, so it names a light color).

blends.description: Colors the engine blends from the roles, set outright. A value is a palette name or a hex.

table-rule.description: The thin rule between table rows (default: 20% foreground on surface).

table-band.description: Every second table row's fill (default: 60% surface on the paper).

caution-fill.description: The soft field behind a caution slide's body (default: 18% warning on the paper).

alert-text.description: Warnings and errors in code (default: 72% accent on dark).

rule.description: Hairlines: the content title's rule and the chart grid (default: 30% foreground on surface).

geometry.description: The slides' furniture, in fractions of the slide.

margin.description: The side margin of every slide, of the width.

tab-width.description: The width of the accent tab at the paper's edge beside titles, of the width.

corner.description: The content slides' corner for the mark; none drops the mark from every slide.

height.description: The mark's height on content slides.

top.description: The mark's distance from the top on content slides.

aspect.description: The mark's width over its height (the lockup's image).

inset.description: The mark's distance from its side edge on content slides, of the width (default: the margin).

title-height.description: The mark's height on the cover.

section-height.description: The mark's height on section slides.

closing-height.description: The mark's height on the closing slide.

pad.description: The margin round the figure, of the width.

footline.description: The strip kept free at the foot, where the page number sits.

caption.description: The caption line's height, above the footline.

label.description: The eyebrow's word over the heading, as "SECTION n" (each format sets it in capitals); null: no eyebrow.

tab.description: The accent tab beside the heading.

label-color.description: The eyebrow's color, a role or a hex.

art.description: Pictures and curves behind the fields. A path is relative to the livery.

title.description: A picture covering the cover's field.

section.description: A picture covering section slides' field.

closing.description: A picture covering the closing slide's field (a band livery's default: title's).

content.description: A picture behind every content slide.

titlegraphic.description: The cover photo for decks that set none (a deck's titlegraphic: none keeps the plain cover).

waves.description: The brand's wave lines, drawn by the engine in the roles' colors: bands on the cover, section and closing slides, faint lines behind content slides.

lines.description: Three lines from the top edge to the bottom, each two cubic curves as seven [x, y] points (start, two controls, the joint, two controls, end), fractions of the slide, y down.

shift.description: How far right of the drawn position each slide kind shows them, of the width.

title.description: On the cover and closing slides.

signoff.description: A second lockup at the foot of every slide but feature and full ones.

light.description: The lockup on the paper (a _brand.yml logo.images name).

dark.description: The lockup on the primary field (a _brand.yml logo.images name).

style.description: cover: the text beside the photo or the waves on the primary field; band: a band across a field holding the text, the photo right of it, the marks in the strip below.

top.description: A band cover: the band's top.

bottom.description: A band cover: the band's bottom.

split.description: A band cover: where the text ends and the photo starts, of the width.

band.description: A band cover: the band's color.

field.description: A band cover: the field's color around the band (its marks are marks.<field>).

field-text.description: A band cover: text on the field (the small print, the closing slide).

logo-height.description: A band cover: the mark's height in the strip (default: geometry.logo.title-height).

signoff-height.description: A band cover: the sign-off's height in the strip (default: signoff.height).

marks.description: Which mark and sign-off each field wears, by the field's role: background (content slides; default logo.medium.light, signoff.light), primary (covers, sections, the closing; default the dark ones), any other role the primary's.

additionalProperties.description: The images on a field of this role.

compositions.description: Overrides of the composed slides' boxes and colors, by slide; every slide takes the parts of compositions.<name> below.

title.x-slide: The cover (an override reaches its photo and light variants).

title-photo.x-slide: The cover with the deck's photo.

title-photo-light.x-slide: The light cover with the deck's photo.

closing.x-slide: The closing slide (an override reaches its light variant).

closing-band.x-slide: The closing slide of a band livery.

style.description: bar: the photo under a dark title bar, the body on a translucent panel; cover: the cover's field, waves and mark with the photo in its right part.

align.description: The title's alignment in the room beside the mark.

tab.description: The accent tab at the paper's edge beside the title.

marking.description: A marking strip on every slide (a restriction or distribution marking, CUI and the like): its look. Its text is the deck's `marking:` (front matter; `marking: none` turns a livery's default off), else text here.

text.description: The default text every deck under the livery shows (default: none, no strip).

width.description: Its width, of the slide's width.

align.description: Where it sits along the edge (left and right at the margin) and how its text aligns.

fill.description: A fill behind it, a role or a hex, to make it stand out (default: none).

text-role.description: Its text's color (default: muted, or primary-text over a fill).

installed-fonts.description: A proprietary face to prefer over the bundled stand-in where the machine has it: a family name (its four faces named the usual way) or {family, faces}.

oneOf.description: A family with its faces named.

faces.description: The faces by their names on the machine, each [full name, PostScript name].

oneOf.description: A family with its faces named.

faces.description: The faces by their names on the machine, each [full name, PostScript name].

colors.description: LaTeX names for palette colors, by palette name (default: the name in CamelCase).

typeface.description: The font PowerPoint sets body text in (the theme's minor font).

heading-typeface.description: The font PowerPoint sets titles in (default: typeface).

fonts.description: A directory of .fntdata files to embed in each deck; without it, the deck embeds no fonts.

size.description: The slide in inches, [width, height]; type: sizes are points on it.

scheme.description: Theme color slots set outright (default: each slot's role). A value is a palette name or a hex.

type.description: Text sizes in points on the pptx.size canvas, whole or half points. A role left out is the engine's default (given here on 13.333 x 7.5 in) scaled to the canvas; subhead, table, code, caption and footnote also scale with the body.

body.description: Body text and the first list level.

title.description: The deck's title on the cover.

fineprint.description: The small print under the cover's title block (e.g. a funding statement).

sectionsubtitle.description: The paragraph under a section slide's heading.

eyebrow.description: The "SECTION n" label over a section slide's heading.

levels.description: The five list levels, the first the body.

charts.description: The chart colors: where a palette for plots comes from. With none of these, the engine generates one from the brand's colors that passes the dataviz checks.

anchors.description: Brand hues the categorical series must start with, in order.

extended.description: More brand hues to use, in order, before any are generated (default: the palette's chromatic colors).

avoid.description: Hue ranges the generated series stay out of, each {hue, width} in degrees (OKLCH; width 30 by default).

chroma.description: How saturated the generated series are (OKLCH chroma; default: the brand hues', within 0.11-0.17).

ramps.description: A brand's published color ramps, light to dark, by name: they become color maps and steer the categorical series.

maps.description: More color maps, light to dark, by name, which leave the categorical series alone.

sets.description: A brand's published series sets by size, for plots of n series.

categorical.description: The series colors in order, pinned (a brand's published set); the first eight are PowerPoint's Custom Colors row.

default-map.description: The color map heatmaps and other continuous plots use by default: a ramps or maps name, or a color, whose nearest ramp is taken.

diverging.description: A diverging scale, pinned: two colors are its poles, more are the whole scale.

dark.description: The same pins for dark slides; what is left out follows the light ones.

categorical.description: The series colors in order, pinned (a brand's published set); the first eight are PowerPoint's Custom Colors row.

default-map.description: The color map heatmaps and other continuous plots use by default: a ramps or maps name, or a color, whose nearest ramp is taken.

diverging.description: A diverging scale, pinned: two colors are its poles, more are the whole scale.

color.description: A _brand.yml palette name or a #RRGGBB hex.

color-or-role.description: A role, a palette name or a #RRGGBB hex.

role-or-hex.description: A role name or a #RRGGBB hex.

path.description: A file path, relative to the livery.

box.description: [x, y, width, height] in fractions of the slide, y down.

brand.description: What the engine reads of _brand.yml (the brand.yml standard); the rest is not checked.

composition.description: The parts of one composed slide; a part not named keeps the engine's value, null removes it.

role.description: The role it is drawn in.

field.description: The colored field behind everything. (null: none)

oneOf.description: Which art.<kind> picture covers the field: title, section, closing or content.

art.description: Which art.<kind> picture covers the field: title, section, closing or content. (null: none)

oneOf.description: The band across a band cover's field.

role.description: The role it is drawn in.

band.description: The band across a band cover's field. (null: none)

oneOf.description: The wave lines drawn over the field.

style.description: Translucent bands between the lines, the lines alone, or the cover's field edge.

shift.description: How far right of the cover art's position they are drawn, of the width.

line.description: The lines' thickness, of the height.

waves.description: The wave lines drawn over the field. (null: none)

role.description: The role it is drawn in.

opacity.description: How opaque it is over the photo.

bar.description: The feature slide's title bar. (null: none)

role.description: The role it is drawn in.

opacity.description: How opaque it is over the photo.

panel.description: The feature slide's body panel. (null: none)

role.description: The role it is drawn in.
The role it is drawn in.

oneOf.description: The text column: title, subtitle, date and the rest.

role.description: The role it is drawn in.

anchor.description: Whether the text hangs from the column's top or is centered in it.

align.description: The text's alignment in the column (default left); a centered column centers its rule too.

elements.description: A cover's column: its elements in order (default date, title, subtitle, author, institute, less a boxed byline's); the title is always here, its tab and rule with it.

tab.description: The accent tab beside the heading.

rule.description: The short rule under the title, [width of the slide's width, thickness of its height], or null for none.

column.description: The text column: title, subtitle, date and the rest. (null: none)

oneOf.description: A cover's byline: elements in their own color (role) and, with a box, their own stack apart from the column.

role.description: The role it is drawn in (default: the column's).

box.description: Where its stack sits; without one its elements stay in the column's flow, in the byline's color.

anchor.description: Whether its stack hangs from the box's top (default) or is centered in it.

elements.description: Its elements in order (default author, institute, date); never the title.

byline.description: A cover's byline, apart from the title: author, institute, date by default. (null: none, every element in the column)

role.description: The role it is drawn in.

anchor.description: Whether the text hangs from the box's top or stands on its bottom.
